Band.description: Band groups a number into ranges: a fixed width, or ascending boundaries where the last range is open-ended. A grouped value is the lower bound of its range.

width.description: Width is the size of every range.

Chart.description: Chart draws columns the report already returns.

compare.description: Compare is the value column a KPI tile compares with.

goal.description: Goal draws a target line or a KPI target.

lat.description: Lat is the latitude column of a map.

limit.description: Limit caps the categories drawn; zero draws all.

lng.description: Lng is the longitude column of a map.

pointLabel.description: PointLabel names each point of a map; empty uses the first dimension.

series.description: Series are the value columns drawn.

showValues.description: ShowValues labels each mark with its value.

x.description: X is the dimension column on the category axis, or the measure on a scatter plot's x axis.

Column.description: Column is one column of a report: exactly one of a dimension, a measure, a calculation or a window over another column.

calc.description: Calc computes the column from a formula over other columns, fields and parameters.

display.description: Display is the author's display spec, an object of the analytics/format package.

format.description: Format is a format hint for the display spec, such as "money" or "percent".

hidden.description: Hidden computes the column for other columns, having or sort without returning it.

id.description: ID names the column in formulas, sort, charts and output; letters, digits and underscores.

label.description: Label is the column heading; empty derives one from the field.

transform.description: Transform rewrites the column's value in SQL.

window.description: Window computes the column across the grouped rows.

Count.description: Count is a whole number or the name of an int parameter that supplies it. It encodes as a number, or as {"param": "name"}.

param.description: The name of the parameter that supplies the value.

DashboardFilter.description: DashboardFilter is a dashboard-wide condition on a field. It narrows every tile whose report starts from the same entity, without the report declaring anything.

default.description: Default is the value used before anyone picks one.

entity.description: Entity is the entity whose reports the filter narrows.

field.description: Field is the dotted path of the field compared.

id.description: ID names the filter; its value is supplied under this id.

label.description: Label is the filter's heading on the dashboard.

Definition.description: Definition is a report: the entity it starts from, its output columns, filters, layout, parameters and charts.

charts.description: Charts draw the output; they never change what is queried.

columns.description: Columns are the report's columns in display order.

entity.description: Entity is the catalog key of the entity the report starts from, such as "shipment".

filters.description: Filters narrow the source rows before grouping.

groupings.description: Groupings adds subtotal and total rows.

having.description: Having narrows the grouped rows by output columns.

limit.description: Limit caps the number of output rows; zero means the runner's limit.

page.description: Page asks for one page of the sorted output.

parameters.description: Parameters are the values the report asks for when it runs.

pivot.description: Pivot spreads measure columns across the values of a field.

top.description: Top keeps the first N rows per group by a column.

version.description: Version is the definition format version; Decode upgrades older versions.

Dimension.description: Dimension groups the report by a field, optionally bucketed in time or banded into ranges.

band.description: Band groups a number into ranges.

bucket.description: Bucket truncates a date or time to a period, or names a parameter that chooses one.

field.description: Field is the dotted path of the field, such as "customer.name".

Filter.description: Filter is a node of a filter tree: a group (And or Or, possibly empty) or a condition. A condition compares a subject, which is exactly one of Field, Calc or Column, with Op and a Value or a Param. A Calc with no Op is a condition when the formula is true.

and.description: And holds conditions that must all hold.

calc.description: Calc is a row-level formula compared, or a boolean formula used as the condition.

column.description: Column is the output column compared; in Having, or a row-level column in Filters.

field.description: Field is the dotted path of the field compared.

or.description: Or holds conditions of which one must hold.

param.description: Param names the parameter that supplies the value instead.

transform.description: Transform rewrites the subject before it is compared.

value.description: Value is the value compared with: a scalar, a list for in and not_in, [from, to] for between, a day count for last_n_days and next_n_days.

Formula.description: Expr is a formula as it appears in a report definition: text a person typed, or an AST a structured editor built. It encodes in the form it was given: a JSON string for text, an object for an AST.

FormulaNode.description: Node is one node of a formula AST. Kind decides which other fields are set; in JSON a node is an object keyed by its kind, such as {"column": "revenue"} or {"call": "round", "args": […]}.

Goal.description: Goal is a chart target: a fixed number or a value column.

column.description: Column is a value column holding the target.

Grain.description: Grain is a bucket, or the name of a string parameter that chooses one when the report runs. It encodes as "month", or as {"param": "name"}.

param.description: The name of the parameter that supplies the value.

Groupings.description: Groupings adds subtotal rows and a grand total row, computed in the same statement as the rows.

subtotals.description: Subtotals lists dimension columns; each adds rows grouped by that column and every dimension column before it.

total.description: Total adds a grand total row.

Measure.description: Measure aggregates a field over each group, optionally over a subset of its rows.

field.description: Field is the dotted path of the aggregated field; empty counts rows.

filter.description: Filter narrows the rows this measure aggregates without narrowing the report.

Page.description: Page asks for one page of the sorted output with keyset paging.

after.description: After is the opaque cursor of the previous page's last row.

size.description: Size is the number of rows in the page.

Parameter.description: Parameter is a value the report asks for when it runs.

allowed.description: Allowed restricts the values that can be given.

default.description: Default is used when no value is given; a list when Multi.

entity.description: Entity is the catalog key of the entity a ref parameter points at.

label.description: Label is the prompt shown to the person running the report.

multi.description: Multi takes a list of values.

name.description: Name is how filters, formulas and settings reference the parameter.

required.description: Required refuses to run without a value or a default.

Pivot.description: Pivot spreads measure columns into one column per value of a field.

columns.description: Columns are the measure columns to spread.

field.description: Field is the dotted path of the field whose values become columns.

labels.description: Labels are column headings for listed values, in the same order.

other.description: Other adds a column for every value not listed or discovered, nulls included.

top.description: Top discovers the values when the report runs: the first N by a measure.

values.description: Values lists the values to spread, or names a multi-value parameter.

PivotTop.description: PivotTop discovers pivot values: the N values with the largest measure.

by.description: By is the measure column that ranks the values.

n.description: N is how many values to discover, or a parameter.

Sort.description: Sort orders the output by a column.

column.description: Column is an output column id, or a pivot cell "column:value".

Top.description: Top keeps the first N rows of each group, ranked by a column.

bottom.description: Bottom keeps the smallest values instead of the largest.

by.description: By is the column that ranks the rows.

n.description: N is how many rows to keep, or a parameter.

per.description: Per lists the dimension columns that form the groups; empty ranks the whole result.

Transform.description: Transform rewrites a value in SQL, so exports, sorting and filters see the rewritten value.

factor.description: Factor is the multiplier for scale.

precision.description: Precision is the number of decimal places for round, ceil, floor and truncate.

Values.description: Values is a list of values or the name of a multi-value parameter that supplies them. It encodes as an array, or as {"param": "name"}.

param.description: The name of the parameter that supplies the value.

Window.description: Window computes a value across the grouped rows from another column.

desc.description: Desc ranks the largest value first.

of.description: Of is the column the window reads.

offset.description: Offset is how many rows back change and percent_change compare with; zero means one.

over.description: Over is the column that orders the rows, for running, moving, change and first/last.

partition.description: Partition restarts the window for each combination of these dimension columns.

size.description: Size is the number of rows a moving average spans.

description: Definition is a report: the entity it starts from, its output columns, filters, layout, parameters and charts.
